note: Structured companion to ROBOT_INFERENCE_RULES.md. Human-readable rules that govern the parse -> derive -> match workflow. Status: implemented | partial | planned.

rules.then: manipulation-morphology evidence (does not override sibling/off-subject gate)

rules.rule: do not infer transport from mobility; transport requires claims_item_delivery; tote_transport requires warehouse tote/cart evidence
human-in-the-loop picking (person-to-goods / workers pick) grounds transport, never manipulate

rules.then: bipedal + mobile_base; arm_count=2 when hand/effector present

rules.rule: 2 arms + 2 hands + vision + mobile body => likely mobile-manipulation platform, but payload/reach/autonomy each need their own evidence
AMR != cannot manipulate; grounds manipulate/tote_transport only from its own configuration evidence
humanoid does not auto-grant palletize; needs manipulation + payload/throughput evidence
facts from sibling products may not flow into the selected product
do not infer a capability from company-level copy when the selected product has no supporting hardware
optional modules must be represented as configurations, not universal product capabilities
a job requirement is MATCHED only if the specific required capability is grounded; generic mobile is a gate
any required UNMET => NOT_A_MATCH; unknowns preserved, never guessed; no match percentage

if: product_class in {agriculture, agricultural_robot} | claims_agriculture | LaserWeeder / carbonrobotics.com weeding evidence
rules.then: agriculture_task + mobile (named derivation; empty specs stay UNKNOWN)
marine_task + mobile (hull/port/underwater — not a category dump)
avionics_task + mobile (hangar/airside aircraft work — not consumer drone)
